rule_selection_reason: 原题具有明确的输出性质（YES/NO）可作为反向目标，且存在自然的自由度（设计输入向量C）进行逆问题转化，而canonical_witness因种子题缺少可直接规范化的解对象（操作序列）且无法保证规范解的可构造性而不适用。；创新度判断：将正向决策改为参数设计：要求从A、B反推满足可达条件的C并附加优化责任，核心义务从YES/NO判定跳转到构造性约束求解与最优化证明。；难度判断：算法需要解决丢番图方程的存在性及最小范数问题，增加了整数线性方程组解的构造与优化复杂度。；风险判断：C的可行解可能不唯一或不存在，需明确处理无解输出；但核心规律不变，风险可控。

components.role_description: Coordinates of the initial vector A
Coordinates of the target vector B

constraints.name: allowed_operations
constraints.description: Only two operations are permitted on the current vector: rotate by 90 degrees clockwise, and add a fixed vector C.

objective.description: 判断是否可以通过旋转和向量加法操作将初始向量变换为目标向量

invariants.name: reachable_difference_lattice
invariants.description: For any fixed starting vector, the set of reachable vectors after any sequence of 90-degree rotations and additions of C is exactly that starting vector plus the integer lattice generated by C and its 90-degree rotated image. Hence, a target vector is reachable if and only if the difference lies in this lattice.

invariants.name: rotation_coset_enumeration
invariants.description: The rotation operation generates a cyclic group of order 4. Because rotations can be applied at any time, the overall set of vectors reachable from A is the union of four cosets, each corresponding to a distinct rotated version of A. The solution correctly checks all four possibilities.

details.feedback: 可考虑选择具有天然决策冲突、最优策略或轮流机制的种子题，例如取石子游戏、棋盘移动博弈等，以保证对抗语义源于原题内在结构。

details.feedback: 该规则不适合此种子题。原题没有适合扩成覆盖或割的局部对象族，强行扩展会变成无关附加限制，违反红线。
